items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: I met him the day before yesterday... I'm the first one taught Battle House a chord on the guitar.

ctx.x: Well did you hear many guys walking around serenading? Oh yeah, yeah.

A lot of guys. I used to serenade myself. After I used to play mandolin, you know. Yeah. Yeah. Well, there's a fella around here that call him Battle House. He's around here. He's one of the lead serenaders. Yeah. I met him the day before yesterday. Now uptown. He sure was glad to see me. He picked the guitar, you know. Picked all them old breakdowns and things. You know, he used to play for those fish fries. Wherever you see a lantern hanging outside the house with the red paper over it, it had fish fry there.…
What is, what is Battle House special in? What kind of numbers?
